mapper.sql: id, bug_id, filename, content_type, size_bytes, storage_path, created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bug_attachment (bug_id, filename, content_type, size_bytes, storage_path, created_at) VALUES (#{bugId}, #{filename}, #{contentType}, #{sizeBytes}, #{storagePath}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.bug_id, a.filename, a.content_type, a.size_bytes, a.storage_path, a.created_at FROM bug_attachment a JOIN bug b ON b.id = a.bug_id JOIN project p ON p.id = b.project_id WHERE a.id = #{id} AND b.deleted = 0 AND p.owner_id = #{ownerId}
SELECT FROM bug_attachment WHERE bug_id = #{bugId} ORDER BY id
